rv.q: ...you’ll be surprised by just how natural the unknown can feel

It is a story of wonder, fear, loss, discovery, and love, all wrapped in a cloak of darkness. It is a tale illuminated by all the senses except sight. It is a show worth experiencing as an exemplar of the art of dramatic performance in the grand tradition of theater.
The whole show is fun, it's passionate, it's emotional.
Although one can’t see the actors, the vocal work is outstanding, especially from Drutman and Andrés Montejo as Christian.
